CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. City Region is the Banjar City Region.
2. City Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of the Regional Government administrator who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Banjar.
4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution that is positioned as an element of the Regional Government administration.
5. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government that is the authority of the region.
6. Protection of women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
7. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
8. Woman is a person who is female by sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.
9. Child is a person who has not yet reached 18 (eighteen) years of age, including a child who is still in the womb.
10. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the Regional territory.
11. Violence is any act against women and children that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.
12. Women's empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to undertake business/enterprise and work independently after being recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.
13. Gender is a concept that refers to the roles and responsibilities of men and women that occur as a result of and can be changed by the social and cultural conditions of society.
14. Social rehabilitation is recovery from disturbances to physical, psychological and social conditions in order to be able to carry out their role again properly both in the family and in society.
15. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with their families and communities.
16. Assistance is an activity to provide counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims carried out by a person or representative of an institution that has expertise.
17. Prevention is the effort of the government together with families and communities as well as the private sector and/or business world to prevent the occurrence of violence through socialization, education, advocacy and promotion activities.
18. Handling is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing, and knowing that violence against victims will, is and/or has occurred.
19. Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy, and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
20. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in a straight line upward or downward up to the third degree.
21. Integrated Service Center for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a technical implementing unit of the Regional Apparatus that carries out technical operational activities and/or technical support activities for integrated services for women and children victims of violence.
22. Forum for the Protection of Victims of Violence hereinafter abbreviated as FPKK is a coordination forum for the prevention, handling and empowerment of victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner and is formed at the Regional, sub-district, and village levels.

Article 4

1. The objectives of protection for women victims of violence are directed to:
a. create conditions that support the development of the potential of women victims of violence;
b. strengthen the potential already possessed by women victims of violence; and
c. improve the work skills of women victims of violence.
2. The objectives of protection for child victims of violence are directed to:
a. provide social rehabilitation for child victims of violence;
b. reunite child victims of violence with their families and/or environment; and
c. improve the empowerment of child victims of violence.

CHAPTER II

PRINCIPLES, PRINCIPLES, AND OBJECTIVES

Article 2

Protection of women and children victims of violence is implemented based on the principles of:

a. respect and recognition of rights; and
b. equal human dignity.

Article 12

1. Prevention of Violence against Children as referred to in Article 11 letter a is implemented by: a. forming a network in efforts to Prevent Violence against Children;
b. conducting coordination, integration, synchronization of Violence Prevention based on partnership patterns with communities, the private sector and Non-Governmental Organizations; and c. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the Protection of Child Victims of Violence.
2. Prevention of Violence against Children as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out in an integrated manner and coordinated by the Regional Apparatus responsible for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection.

CHAPTER X

GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

Article 29

1. Guidance and supervision of the implementation of Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence is carried out by the Regional Agency in charge of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection.
2. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) include:
a. coordination;
b. guidance;
c. education and training; and
d. monitoring and evaluation.
3. Coordination as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a covers aspects related to planning and implementation.
4. Guidance as referred to in paragraph (2) letter b covers aspects related to planning, implementation, procedures, financing, quality, control and supervision.
5. Education and training as referred to in paragraph (2) letter c is carried out in accordance with laws and regulations.
6. Monitoring and evaluation as referred to in paragraph (2) letter d is carried out regularly every 3 (three) months.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Economic factors, social environment and technological developments have a major influence on the increase in such acts of violence.

This condition requires the Regional Government to take concrete steps through program activities as an effort to prevent and protect women and children from acts of violence. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families. Efforts to prevent violence against children are the obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector.

Community service is the front line when there is potential violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

Article 5

The stages of protection for women victims of violence include:
a. prevention of violence against women;
b. protection services for women victims of violence; and
c. empowerment of women victims of violence.

CHAPTER VI

OBLIGATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

OF REGIONAL GOVERNMENT

Article 17

1. The City Regional Government implements efforts to prevent violence against Women and Children in the form of:
a. collecting data and organizing an information system for the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence;
b. conducting education on anti-violence values towards Women and Children; and
c. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to Women's Empowerment and Protection of Child Victims of Violence.
2. The City Regional Government is obligated and responsible to provide and organize services for Victims in the form of:
a. establishing and organizing technical service institutions for Victims by involving community elements; and
b. encouraging community awareness of the importance of protection for Victims of violence.

Paragraph 1

Article 26

1. In addition to P2TP2A as referred to in Article 20, the community may form forums or groups at the sub-district and village levels that function as P2TP2A networks in the framework of implementing efforts to Protect Women and Children Victims of Violence.
2. The formation of forums or groups in villages as referred to in paragraph (1) may be facilitated by the Village Government.

Article 3

Letter a What is meant by "gender responsive" is that all service officers must be gender sensitive when exploring the problems experienced by victims and can provide protection to women and child victims of violence.

Letter b What is meant by "non-discrimination" is that the implementation of protection for women and child victims of violence is provided to every woman and/or every child and is not differentiated based on ethnicity, religion, race, class, gender, ethnicity, culture and language, legal status, and physical or mental condition.

Article 28

1. The Regional Agency in charge of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection conducts monitoring, evaluation, and reporting of the results of Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence activities on a regular basis.
2. Reporting of activity results as referred to in paragraph (1) is submitted to the Mayor through the Regional Agency in charge of regional development planning.
3. The implementation of monitoring, evaluation and reporting as referred to in paragraph (1) involves the forum for handling victims of violence against women and children in a tiered manner.

Part Three

Article 23

1. In order to protect and guarantee the rights of women and children from acts of violence, FPKK is established.
2. FPKK as referred to in paragraph (1) consists of:
a. City Regional FPKK;
b. Sub-district FPKK; and
c. Village FPKK.
3. Provisions regarding the procedures for establishment, organizational structure, and elements of FPKK as referred to in paragraph (2) are regulated by Mayor Regulation.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Economic factors, social environment and technological developments have a major influence on the increase in such acts of violence.

This condition requires the Regional Government to take concrete steps through program activities as an effort to prevent and protect women and children from acts of violence. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families. Efforts to prevent violence against children are the obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector.

Community service is the front line when there is potential violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Economic factors, social environment and technological developments have a major influence on the increase in such acts of violence.

This condition requires the Regional Government to take concrete steps through program activities as an effort to prevent and protect women and children from acts of violence. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families. Efforts to prevent violence against children are the obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector.

Community service is the front line when there is potential violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

Article 12

2. Prevention of Violence against Children as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out in an integrated manner and coordinated by the Regional Apparatus responsible for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection.

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. City Region is the Banjar City Region.
2. City Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of the Regional Government administrator who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Banjar.
4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution that is positioned as an element of the Regional Government administration.
5. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government that is the authority of the region.
6. Protection of women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
7. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
8. Woman is a person who is female by sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.
9. Child is a person who has not yet reached 18 (eighteen) years of age, including a child who is still in the womb.
10. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the Regional territory.
11. Violence is any act against women and children that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.
12. Women's empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to undertake business/enterprise and work independently after being recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.
13. Gender is a concept that refers to the roles and responsibilities of men and women that occur as a result of and can be changed by the social and cultural conditions of society.
14. Social rehabilitation is recovery from disturbances to physical, psychological and social conditions in order to be able to carry out their role again properly both in the family and in society.
15. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with their families and communities.
16. Assistance is an activity to provide counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims carried out by a person or representative of an institution that has expertise.
17. Prevention is the effort of the government together with families and communities as well as the private sector and/or business world to prevent the occurrence of violence through socialization, education, advocacy and promotion activities.
18. Handling is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing, and knowing that violence against victims will, is and/or has occurred.
19. Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy, and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
20. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in a straight line upward or downward up to the third degree.
21. Integrated Service Center for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a technical implementing unit of the Regional Apparatus that carries out technical operational activities and/or technical support activities for integrated services for women and children victims of violence.
22. Forum for the Protection of Victims of Violence hereinafter abbreviated as FPKK is a coordination forum for the prevention, handling and empowerment of victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner and is formed at the Regional, sub-district, and village levels.

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

7. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

9. Child is a person who has not yet reached 18 (eighteen) years of age, including a child who is still in the womb.

11. Violence is any act against women and children that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.
12. Women's empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to undertake business/enterprise and work independently after being recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.
13. Gender is a concept that refers to the roles and responsibilities of men and women that occur as a result of and can be changed by the social and cultural conditions of society.
14. Social rehabilitation is recovery from disturbances to physical, psychological and social conditions in order to be able to carry out their role again properly both in the family and in society.
15. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with their families and communities.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Economic factors, social environment and technological developments have a major influence on the increase in such acts of violence.

This condition requires the Regional Government to take concrete steps through program activities as an effort to prevent and protect women and children from acts of violence. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families. Efforts to prevent violence against children are the obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector.

Community service is the front line when there is potential violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Economic factors, social environment and technological developments have a major influence on the increase in such acts of violence.

This condition requires the Regional Government to take concrete steps through program activities as an effort to prevent and protect women and children from acts of violence. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families. Efforts to prevent violence against children are the obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector.

Community service is the front line when there is potential violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. City Region is the Banjar City Region.
2. City Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of the Regional Government administrator who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Banjar.
4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution that is positioned as an element of the Regional Government administration.
5. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government that is the authority of the region.
6. Protection of women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
7. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
8. Woman is a person who is female by sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.
9. Child is a person who has not yet reached 18 (eighteen) years of age, including a child who is still in the womb.
10. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the Regional territory.
11. Violence is any act against women and children that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.
12. Women's empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to undertake business/enterprise and work independently after being recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.
13. Gender is a concept that refers to the roles and responsibilities of men and women that occur as a result of and can be changed by the social and cultural conditions of society.
14. Social rehabilitation is recovery from disturbances to physical, psychological and social conditions in order to be able to carry out their role again properly both in the family and in society.
15. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with their families and communities.
16. Assistance is an activity to provide counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims carried out by a person or representative of an institution that has expertise.
17. Prevention is the effort of the government together with families and communities as well as the private sector and/or business world to prevent the occurrence of violence through socialization, education, advocacy and promotion activities.
18. Handling is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing, and knowing that violence against victims will, is and/or has occurred.
19. Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy, and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
20. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in a straight line upward or downward up to the third degree.
21. Integrated Service Center for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a technical implementing unit of the Regional Apparatus that carries out technical operational activities and/or technical support activities for integrated services for women and children victims of violence.
22. Forum for the Protection of Victims of Violence hereinafter abbreviated as FPKK is a coordination forum for the prevention, handling and empowerment of victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner and is formed at the Regional, sub-district, and village levels.

CHAPTER VI

OBLIGATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

OF REGIONAL GOVERNMENT

Article 17

1. The City Regional Government implements efforts to prevent violence against Women and Children in the form of:
a. collecting data and organizing an information system for the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence;
b. conducting education on anti-violence values towards Women and Children; and
c. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to Women's Empowerment and Protection of Child Victims of Violence.
2. The City Regional Government is obligated and responsible to provide and organize services for Victims in the form of:
a. establishing and organizing technical service institutions for Victims by involving community elements; and
b. encouraging community awareness of the importance of protection for Victims of violence.

Article 4

1. The objectives of protection for women victims of violence are directed to:
a. create conditions that support the development of the potential of women victims of violence;
b. strengthen the potential already possessed by women victims of violence; and
c. improve the work skills of women victims of violence.
2. The objectives of protection for child victims of violence are directed to:
a. provide social rehabilitation for child victims of violence;
b. reunite child victims of violence with their families and/or environment; and
c. improve the empowerment of child victims of violence.

Article 26

1. In addition to P2TP2A as referred to in Article 20, the community may form forums or groups at the sub-district and village levels that function as P2TP2A networks in the framework of implementing efforts to Protect Women and Children Victims of Violence.
2. The formation of forums or groups in villages as referred to in paragraph (1) may be facilitated by the Village Government.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Economic factors, social environment and technological developments have a major influence on the increase in such acts of violence.

This condition requires the Regional Government to take concrete steps through program activities as an effort to prevent and protect women and children from acts of violence. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families. Efforts to prevent violence against children are the obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector.

Community service is the front line when there is potential violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

Article 20

1. P2TP2A provides services and temporary protection in the form of a safe house.
2. In the event that P2TP2A does not yet have a safe house as referred to in paragraph (1), victims are referred to other integrated service centers that have safe houses.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Economic factors, social environment and technological developments have a major influence on the increase in such acts of violence.

This condition requires the Regional Government to take concrete steps through program activities as an effort to prevent and protect women and children from acts of violence. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families. Efforts to prevent violence against children are the obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector.

Community service is the front line when there is potential violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Economic factors, social environment and technological developments have a major influence on the increase in such acts of violence.

This condition requires the Regional Government to take concrete steps through program activities as an effort to prevent and protect women and children from acts of violence. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families. Efforts to prevent violence against children are the obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector.

Community service is the front line when there is potential violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. City Region is the Banjar City Region.
2. City Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of the Regional Government administrator who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Banjar.
4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution that is positioned as an element of the Regional Government administration.
5. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government that is the authority of the region.
6. Protection of women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
7. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
8. Woman is a person who is female by sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.
9. Child is a person who has not yet reached 18 (eighteen) years of age, including a child who is still in the womb.
10. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the Regional territory.
11. Violence is any act against women and children that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.
12. Women's empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to undertake business/enterprise and work independently after being recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.
13. Gender is a concept that refers to the roles and responsibilities of men and women that occur as a result of and can be changed by the social and cultural conditions of society.
14. Social rehabilitation is recovery from disturbances to physical, psychological and social conditions in order to be able to carry out their role again properly both in the family and in society.
15. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with their families and communities.

17. Prevention is the effort of the government together with families and communities as well as the private sector and/or business world to prevent the occurrence of violence through socialization, education, advocacy and promotion activities.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Economic factors, social environment and technological developments have a major influence on the increase in such acts of violence.

This condition requires the Regional Government to take concrete steps through program activities as an effort to prevent and protect women and children from acts of violence. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families. Efforts to prevent violence against children are the obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector.

Community service is the front line when there is potential violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CHAPTER VI

OBLIGATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

OF REGIONAL GOVERNMENT

Article 17

1. The City Regional Government implements efforts to prevent violence against Women and Children in the form of:
a. collecting data and organizing an information system for the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence;
b. conducting education on anti-violence values towards Women and Children; and
c. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to Women's Empowerment and Protection of Child Victims of Violence.
2. The City Regional Government is obligated and responsible to provide and organize services for Victims in the form of:
a. establishing and organizing technical service institutions for Victims by involving community elements; and
b. encouraging community awareness of the importance of protection for Victims of violence.

One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families. Efforts to prevent violence against children are the obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector.

Community service is the front line when there is potential violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. City Region is the Banjar City Region.
2. City Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of the Regional Government administrator who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Banjar.
4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution that is positioned as an element of the Regional Government administration.
5. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government that is the authority of the region.
6. Protection of women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
7. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
8. Woman is a person who is female by sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.
9. Child is a person who has not yet reached 18 (eighteen) years of age, including a child who is still in the womb.
10. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the Regional territory.
11. Violence is any act against women and children that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.
12. Women's empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to undertake business/enterprise and work independently after being recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.
13. Gender is a concept that refers to the roles and responsibilities of men and women that occur as a result of and can be changed by the social and cultural conditions of society.
14. Social rehabilitation is recovery from disturbances to physical, psychological and social conditions in order to be able to carry out their role again properly both in the family and in society.
15. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with their families and communities.
16. Assistance is an activity to provide counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims carried out by a person or representative of an institution that has expertise.
17. Prevention is the effort of the government together with families and communities as well as the private sector and/or business world to prevent the occurrence of violence through socialization, education, advocacy and promotion activities.
18. Handling is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing, and knowing that violence against victims will, is and/or has occurred.
19. Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy, and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
20. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in a straight line upward or downward up to the third degree.
21. Integrated Service Center for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a technical implementing unit of the Regional Apparatus that carries out technical operational activities and/or technical support activities for integrated services for women and children victims of violence.
22. Forum for the Protection of Victims of Violence hereinafter abbreviated as FPKK is a coordination forum for the prevention, handling and empowerment of victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner and is formed at the Regional, sub-district, and village levels.

Article 12

1. Prevention of Violence against Children as referred to in Article 11 letter a is implemented by: a. forming a network in efforts to Prevent Violence against Children;
b. conducting coordination, integration, synchronization of Violence Prevention based on partnership patterns with communities, the private sector and Non-Governmental Organizations; and c. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the Protection of Child Victims of Violence.
2. Prevention of Violence against Children as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out in an integrated manner and coordinated by the Regional Apparatus responsible for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection.

Article 5

The stages of protection for women victims of violence include:
a. prevention of violence against women;
b. protection services for women victims of violence; and
c. empowerment of women victims of violence.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Economic factors, social environment and technological developments have a major influence on the increase in such acts of violence.

This condition requires the Regional Government to take concrete steps through program activities as an effort to prevent and protect women and children from acts of violence. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families. Efforts to prevent violence against children are the obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector.

Community service is the front line when there is potential violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

c. implementation of counseling in the spiritual field involving the ministry of religion and religious leaders; dand. implementation of counseling in the psychology field involving psychological assistants and/or psychologists.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Economic factors, social environment and technological developments have a major influence on the increase in such acts of violence.

This condition requires the Regional Government to take concrete steps through program activities as an effort to prevent and protect women and children from acts of violence. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families. Efforts to prevent violence against children are the obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector.

Community service is the front line when there is potential violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Economic factors, social environment and technological developments have a major influence on the increase in such acts of violence.

This condition requires the Regional Government to take concrete steps through program activities as an effort to prevent and protect women and children from acts of violence. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. Efforts to prevent violence against children are the obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector.

Community service is the front line when there is potential violence against children. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

REGIONAL REGULATION OF BANJAR CITY

NUMBER 10 YEAR 2017

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Economic factors, social environment and technological developments have a major influence on the increase in such acts of violence.

This condition requires the Regional Government to take concrete steps through program activities as an effort to prevent and protect women and children from acts of violence. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families. Efforts to prevent violence against children are the obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector.

Community service is the front line when there is potential violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

Paragraph 1

Prevention of Violence Against Women

CHAPTER X

GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

Article 29

1. Guidance and supervision of the implementation of Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence is carried out by the Regional Agency in charge of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection.
2. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) include:
a. coordination;
b. guidance;
c. education and training; and
d. monitoring and evaluation.
3. Coordination as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a covers aspects related to planning and implementation.
4. Guidance as referred to in paragraph (2) letter b covers aspects related to planning, implementation, procedures, financing, quality, control and supervision.
5. Education and training as referred to in paragraph (2) letter c is carried out in accordance with laws and regulations.
6. Monitoring and evaluation as referred to in paragraph (2) letter d is carried out regularly every 3 (three) months.

CHAPTER II

PRINCIPLES, PRINCIPLES, AND OBJECTIVES

Article 2

Protection of women and children victims of violence is implemented based on the principles of:

a. respect and recognition of rights; and
b. equal human dignity.

Article 26

1. In addition to P2TP2A as referred to in Article 20, the community may form forums or groups at the sub-district and village levels that function as P2TP2A networks in the framework of implementing efforts to Protect Women and Children Victims of Violence.
2. The formation of forums or groups in villages as referred to in paragraph (1) may be facilitated by the Village Government.

CHAPTER VI

OBLIGATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

OF REGIONAL GOVERNMENT

Article 17

1. The City Regional Government implements efforts to prevent violence against Women and Children in the form of:
a. collecting data and organizing an information system for the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence;
b. conducting education on anti-violence values towards Women and Children; and
c. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to Women's Empowerment and Protection of Child Victims of Violence.
2. The City Regional Government is obligated and responsible to provide and organize services for Victims in the form of:
a. establishing and organizing technical service institutions for Victims by involving community elements; and
b. encouraging community awareness of the importance of protection for Victims of violence.

CHAPTER IX

MONITORING, EVALUATION, AND REPORTING

Article 27

Monitoring, Evaluation, and Reporting of the protection of women and children victims of violence is coordinated by the Regional Agency in charge of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection.

Paragraph 3

Empowerment of Women Victims of Violence

Article 28

1. The Regional Agency in charge of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection conducts monitoring, evaluation, and reporting of the results of Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence activities on a regular basis.
2. Reporting of activity results as referred to in paragraph (1) is submitted to the Mayor through the Regional Agency in charge of regional development planning.
3. The implementation of monitoring, evaluation and reporting as referred to in paragraph (1) involves the forum for handling victims of violence against women and children in a tiered manner.

Part Three

FPKK

Article 23

1. In order to protect and guarantee the rights of women and children from acts of violence, FPKK is established.
2. FPKK as referred to in paragraph (1) consists of:
a. City Regional FPKK;
b. Sub-district FPKK; and
c. Village FPKK.
3. Provisions regarding the procedures for establishment, organizational structure, and elements of FPKK as referred to in paragraph (2) are regulated by Mayor Regulation.

Article 4

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. City Region is the Banjar City Region.
2. City Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of the Regional Government administrator who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Banjar.
4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution that is positioned as an element of the Regional Government administration.
5. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government that is the authority of the region.
6. Protection of women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
7. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
8. Woman is a person who is female by sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.
9. Child is a person who has not yet reached 18 (eighteen) years of age, including a child who is still in the womb.
10. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the Regional territory.
11. Violence is any act against women and children that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.
12. Women's empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to undertake business/enterprise and work independently after being recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.
13. Gender is a concept that refers to the roles and responsibilities of men and women that occur as a result of and can be changed by the social and cultural conditions of society.
14. Social rehabilitation is recovery from disturbances to physical, psychological and social conditions in order to be able to carry out their role again properly both in the family and in society.
15. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with their families and communities.
16. Assistance is an activity to provide counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims carried out by a person or representative of an institution that has expertise.
17. Prevention is the effort of the government together with families and communities as well as the private sector and/or business world to prevent the occurrence of violence through socialization, education, advocacy and promotion activities.
18. Handling is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing, and knowing that violence against victims will, is and/or has occurred.
19. Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy, and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
20. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in a straight line upward or downward up to the third degree.
21. Integrated Service Center for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a technical implementing unit of the Regional Apparatus that carries out technical operational activities and/or technical support activities for integrated services for women and children victims of violence.
22. Forum for the Protection of Victims of Violence hereinafter abbreviated as FPKK is a coordination forum for the prevention, handling and empowerment of victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner and is formed at the Regional, sub-district, and village levels.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Economic factors, social environment and technological developments have a major influence on the increase in such acts of violence.

This condition requires the Regional Government to take concrete steps through program activities as an effort to prevent and protect women and children from acts of violence. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families. Efforts to prevent violence against children are the obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector.

Community service is the front line when there is potential violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Economic factors, social environment and technological developments have a major influence on the increase in such acts of violence.

This condition requires the Regional Government to take concrete steps through program activities as an effort to prevent and protect women and children from acts of violence. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families. Efforts to prevent violence against children are the obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector.

Community service is the front line when there is potential violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Economic factors, social environment and technological developments have a major influence on the increase in such acts of violence.

This condition requires the Regional Government to take concrete steps through program activities as an effort to prevent and protect women and children from acts of violence. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families. Efforts to prevent violence against children are the obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector.

Community service is the front line when there is potential violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. City Region is the Banjar City Region.
2. City Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of the Regional Government administrator who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Banjar.
4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution that is positioned as an element of the Regional Government administration.
5. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government that is the authority of the region.
6. Protection of women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
7. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
8. Woman is a person who is female by sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.
9. Child is a person who has not yet reached 18 (eighteen) years of age, including a child who is still in the womb.
10. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the Regional territory.
11. Violence is any act against women and children that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.
12. Women's empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to undertake business/enterprise and work independently after being recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.
13. Gender is a concept that refers to the roles and responsibilities of men and women that occur as a result of and can be changed by the social and cultural conditions of society.
14. Social rehabilitation is recovery from disturbances to physical, psychological and social conditions in order to be able to carry out their role again properly both in the family and in society.
15. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with their families and communities.
16. Assistance is an activity to provide counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims carried out by a person or representative of an institution that has expertise.
17. Prevention is the effort of the government together with families and communities as well as the private sector and/or business world to prevent the occurrence of violence through socialization, education, advocacy and promotion activities.
18. Handling is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing, and knowing that violence against victims will, is and/or has occurred.
19. Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy, and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
20. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in a straight line upward or downward up to the third degree.
21. Integrated Service Center for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a technical implementing unit of the Regional Apparatus that carries out technical operational activities and/or technical support activities for integrated services for women and children victims of violence.
22. Forum for the Protection of Victims of Violence hereinafter abbreviated as FPKK is a coordination forum for the prevention, handling and empowerment of victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner and is formed at the Regional, sub-district, and village levels.

CHAPTER VI

OBLIGATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

OF REGIONAL GOVERNMENT

Article 17

1. The City Regional Government implements efforts to prevent violence against Women and Children in the form of:
a. collecting data and organizing an information system for the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence;
b. conducting education on anti-violence values towards Women and Children; and
c. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to Women's Empowerment and Protection of Child Victims of Violence.
2. The City Regional Government is obligated and responsible to provide and organize services for Victims in the form of:
a. establishing and organizing technical service institutions for Victims by involving community elements; and
b. encouraging community awareness of the importance of protection for Victims of violence.

CHAPTER X

GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

Article 29

1. Guidance and supervision of the implementation of Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence is carried out by the Regional Agency in charge of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection.
2. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) include:
a. coordination;
b. guidance;
c. education and training; and
d. monitoring and evaluation.
3. Coordination as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a covers aspects related to planning and implementation.
4. Guidance as referred to in paragraph (2) letter b covers aspects related to planning, implementation, procedures, financing, quality, control and supervision.
5. Education and training as referred to in paragraph (2) letter c is carried out in accordance with laws and regulations.
6. Monitoring and evaluation as referred to in paragraph (2) letter d is carried out regularly every 3 (three) months.

Part Three

FPKK

Article 23

1. In order to protect and guarantee the rights of women and children from acts of violence, FPKK is established.
2. FPKK as referred to in paragraph (1) consists of:
a. City Regional FPKK;
b. Sub-district FPKK; and
c. Village FPKK.
3. Provisions regarding the procedures for establishment, organizational structure, and elements of FPKK as referred to in paragraph (2) are regulated by Mayor Regulation.

Article 28

1. The Regional Agency in charge of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection conducts monitoring, evaluation, and reporting of the results of Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence activities on a regular basis.
2. Reporting of activity results as referred to in paragraph (1) is submitted to the Mayor through the Regional Agency in charge of regional development planning.
3. The implementation of monitoring, evaluation and reporting as referred to in paragraph (1) involves the forum for handling victims of violence against women and children in a tiered manner.

CHAPTER VII

INSTITUTIONS

SUPPLEMENT TO THE REGIONAL GAZETTE OF BANJAR CITY NUMBER 23

Article 26

1. In addition to P2TP2A as referred to in Article 20, the community may form forums or groups at the sub-district and village levels that function as P2TP2A networks in the framework of implementing efforts to Protect Women and Children Victims of Violence.
2. The formation of forums or groups in villages as referred to in paragraph (1) may be facilitated by the Village Government.

Article 12

1. Prevention of Violence against Children as referred to in Article 11 letter a is implemented by: a. forming a network in efforts to Prevent Violence against Children;
b. conducting coordination, integration, synchronization of Violence Prevention based on partnership patterns with communities, the private sector and Non-Governmental Organizations; and c. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the Protection of Child Victims of Violence.
2. Prevention of Violence against Children as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out in an integrated manner and coordinated by the Regional Apparatus responsible for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection.

This Regional Regulation comes into force on the date of promulgation.
