6. Protection of women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
7. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
8. Woman is a person who is female by sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.
9. Child is a person who has not yet reached 18 (eighteen) years of age, including a child who is still in the womb.
10. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the Regional territory.
11. Violence is any act against women and children that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.
12. Women's empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to undertake business/enterprise and work independently after being recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.
13. Gender is a concept that refers to the roles and responsibilities of men and women that occur as a result of and can be changed by the social and cultural conditions of society.
14. Social rehabilitation is recovery from disturbances to physical, psychological and social conditions in order to be able to carry out their role again properly both in the family and in society.
15. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with their families and communities.
16. Assistance is an activity to provide counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims carried out by a person or representative of an institution that has expertise.
17. Prevention is the effort of the government together with families and communities as well as the private sector and/or business world to prevent the occurrence of violence through socialization, education, advocacy and promotion activities.
18. Handling is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing, and knowing that violence against victims will, is and/or has occurred.
19. Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy, and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
20. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in a straight line upward or downward up to the third degree.
21. Integrated Service Center for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a technical implementing unit of the Regional Apparatus that carries out technical operational activities and/or technical support activities for integrated services for women and children victims of violence.
22. Forum for the Protection of Victims of Violence hereinafter abbreviated as FPKK is a coordination forum for the prevention, handling and empowerment of victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner and is formed at the Regional, sub-district, and village levels.

Article 22

Paragraph (1) Letter a What is meant by "medical services" is a form of medical services for the purposes of evidence in the legal field.

Letter b What is meant by "medicolegal services" is treatment and recovery of physical injuries aimed at restoring the physical condition of victims carried out by medical personnel and paramedics.

Letter c What is meant by "psychosocial services" is services provided by assistants in the context of traumatic recovery of the victim's condition including the provision of space and safe houses to protect victims from threats and intimidation.

Letter d What is meant by "legal services" is services to victims in undergoing legal processes.

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasing trend. Economic factors, social environment and technological developments have a major influence on the increase in such acts of violence.

This condition requires the Regional Government to take concrete steps through program activities as an effort to prevent and protect women and children from acts of violence. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families. Efforts to prevent violence against children are the obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector.

Community service is the front line when there is potential violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multiple sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with this matter, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and children victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate it in a Regional Regulation.

CHAPTER X

GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

Article 29

1. Guidance and supervision of the implementation of Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence is carried out by the Regional Agency in charge of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection.
2. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) include:
a. coordination;
b. guidance;
c. education and training; and
d. monitoring and evaluation.
3. Coordination as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a covers aspects related to planning and implementation.
4. Guidance as referred to in paragraph (2) letter b covers aspects related to planning, implementation, procedures, financing, quality, control and supervision.
5. Education and training as referred to in paragraph (2) letter c is carried out in accordance with laws and regulations.
6. Monitoring and evaluation as referred to in paragraph (2) letter d is carried out regularly every 3 (three) months.
